cells.text: Branding Considerations
Your Branding Ideas
Can you define what your product or service DOES for your customer OR, defines YOU and WHAT YOU DO FOR OTHERS in one word?
(examples) Confidence: Beauty: Elegance: Energised: Safe: Calm: Coach:
What does your business name suggest to your target market?
What colours have you chosen and why? (Have you checked the 'colour associations' to people's emotions?)
What image or logo do you use to make recognition easy? (Is it transferable to print and fabric; does it 'scale up and down' for signage and letterhead?)
Can you generate a Value Proposition statement (What it DOES for them or MAKES THEM FEEL) in less than 4 words (preferably 3 or less) to support your imagery?
Gives you Wings: Just do It: Lovin' It: Simplifying Advisory:
Is there a sound or 'jingle' that supports your imagery?
How does your pricing and packaging tactics support your brand position to your customer and again, differentiate you from your competition?
What financial and time budget do you have to carry the message to your market. (Even the most 'sticky' phrase and logo requires both Time & Repetition to make a difference to your business)
Customer Loyalty Considerations
Your Loyalty Ideas
What current data do you have in terms of customer average spend, purchase frequency and product/service utilisation? (do they use a range of your products or just their favourite 1 or 2)
What is the calculated cost of securing a new customer for your business? (and if time is a factor - how long does it take to secure a new customer?)
What is the focus of your loyalty programme? Is it to REDUCE the COST of GAINING a CUSTOMER or, to EXTEND the FREQUENCY and AVERAGE SPEND of your EXISTING customers. (Explain Why?)
What are your average weekly/ monthly referrals and how are they tracked at present?
To be considered 'Remarkable' you must do something that your customer is 'Able to make a Remark about'. What do you do that is worthy of being used in conversation by your customer?
What can you offer your customer (in return for Loyalty as you define it) that is VALUABLE AND UNIQUE? (To THEM)
Does you Loyalty Programme provide 'Status Levels' and if so, is the status revered by your customer?
What metrics do you use (Key Performance Indicators) to measure the effectiveness of your loyalty programme IN INCREASING BUSINESS PROFITS?
Pricing Considerations
Your Pricing Ideas
Which of the three pricing philosophies do you abide by most?
What 'cost calculations' have you conducted to establish your pricing strategies? (What data have you collected to support these calculations?)
What 'competitor calculations' have you conducted to establish your pricing strategies? (What data have you collected to support these calculations?)
What 'customer value calculations' have you conducted to establish your pricing strategies? (What data have you collected to support these calculations?)
What attempts have you made to COMBINE the three pricing philosophies into your product/ services prices?
What do you monitor to support your 'Price Elasticity' range? (What sets the 'upper and lower range' of your prices?)
Packaging & Bundling Considerations
Your Packaging & Bundling Ideas
What have you gained (by way of customer feedback) about the packaging or presentation of your product/ service?
What does your current packaging or presentation attempt to 'say' about your product/ service/ business? (Is it consistent with your branding/ positioning?)

What has influenced your packaging choices? (Weight/Shipping Cost - Recycling/Environment Affect - Utility of 'container' uses (either for product or by customer post delivery) - Shelf Presentation as examples)
Do you use multiple distribution options? If so, would it make sense to have different packaging options to match the 'point of sale' requirements?
What are the 'bundling options' (for your product/service) on offer to your customers?
Do you bundle obscure or 'fringe sellers' to increase the cross-sell chances; or do you bundle 'top sellers' to reduce cost of sale. (Why?)
What is the metric you use (Key Performance Indicator) to assess the effectiveness of your bundling tactics?
